title: RadOnc-Agent：LLM编排的放疗全流程AI工作流框架
summary: 提出RadOnc-Agent，一个基于LLM控制器的智能体框架，将放疗流程形式化为四个临床阶段，提供26个可调用函数。系统在单函数请求中98.79%选择正确函数，跨阶段工作流完成率96.50%，真实患者工作流完成率96.67%。消融实验表明纵向状态和模式验证对性能至关重要。
summary_en: RadOnc-Agent is an LLM-orchestrated agentic framework that formalizes radiotherapy into four clinical phases with 26 callable functions via a conversational interface. It selected the intended function in 98.79% of single-function executions, completed 96.50% of cross-stage workflows, and 96.67% of real-patient workflows. Ablations show longitudinal state and schema validation are critical.
